objective: Reduce LDBC join latency and instability by carrying join-stage projection hints into filtered base scans and indexed join probes.

tasks.title: LDBC join projection pushdown
expected_changes: Use join projection hints when the first relation has a local WHERE predicate.
Use join projection hints for right-side relation scans inside join steps.
Decode only required right-side columns when indexed join probe is used.
Verify with corrupt-unused-column regression tests, join/select/group tests, release build, and LDBC medium repeat.
